summary: Agenda view for events: a semantic list with times, details and composable actions.
whenToUse: Showing a day's events or a schedule in agenda order.
Composing event rows with custom content and actions.
whenNotToUse: Navigating between dates or selecting a day: use a calendar component.
Comparing events as editorial cards: use EventCard.

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the agenda section, also used to label it.

props.name: children
props.description: AgendaItem elements to render as a list.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown when there are no items.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Semantic level of the section title.

inherits: HTML attributes of <section> (except title); ref forwarded to the section.

keyboard.action: Reaches the links and controls placed inside agenda items.
Activates a standard link or control in the item.

accessibility: The section is labeled by the title and events are contained in an ordered list.
Times use <time>; pass ISO values via startDateTime/endDateTime to provide machine-readable dates.
Actions are content slots; the component creates no nested interactive controls.
responsive: Rows switch to a single column in narrow containers; details and actions can wrap.
customization: `className` on the root and on rows; colors, surfaces and spacing use `--dc-*` tokens.
commonMistakes: Using AgendaItem outside Agenda: it is an <li> element and requires a containing list.
Passing human-readable values as `startDateTime`; visible text belongs in `startTime`.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Daily schedule
examples.description: Ordered events with time, link, location and action.

examples.name: Empty
examples.title: Empty state
examples.description: Message shown when the agenda contains no events.

limits: Sorting events and grouping them by date remain the caller's responsibility.
